title: Emergency plan
intro: A short card about your child and up to three trusted contacts. Only people you choose can receive it.

childCard.heading: Child card
childCard.label: Needs, medicines, how to calm, fears
childCard.hint: Free text, up to 2000 characters. Stored encrypted.
childCard.empty: Your child's card will appear here once you save it.

contacts.heading: Trusted contacts
contacts.emptyDescription: Add up to three people you trust. A member can become a contact if you have met in person and she accepts the invitation.
contacts.name: Name
contacts.invalidPhone: Please check the number: it needs the international format, for example +70000000000.
contacts.full: You already have three trusted contacts. To add someone new, remove one from the list first.

send.heading: Send the plan
send.description: Confirmed contacts receive a notification. External contacts get an SMS without the card text.
send.confirm: Send the child card to your confirmed trusted contacts now?
send.needCard: Save a child card before sending.
send.needContact: Add at least one confirmed trusted contact before sending.

saveError: Could not save. Check your connection and try again.
loadError: Could not load the plan. Please try again in a moment.

external.title: Information shared with you
external.intro: {{name}} shared this with you in case she needs your help with her child.
external.expiredDescription: You can ask her to send the plan again.
external.busyTitle: Let us take a short pause
external.busyDescription: You can open the link again in a few minutes.
